```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
Import Rhinovirus data csv file 
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
ggplot(rhinovirus)

ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Metric Value") +
  ggtitle("Metric Value by Date")
```
